summary: Matt Busker of Grand Junction, last seen in Ouray on 2013-06-15, reported missing; his vehicle was found near Black Bear Pass in San Miguel County and a multi-agency search (K-9, ATVs, foot, aerial) was suspended with no sign of him. His body was later found in the Black Bear Mine east of Telluride, about two miles from the vehicle, with an apparent self-inflicted gunshot wound per the San Miguel County Sheriff's Office.
location: Black Bear Mine, east of Telluride, ~2 miles from abandoned vehicle on Black Bear Pass
